title: fylgja twin verify — the verify block (M12)
description: The `verify` block of the findings document fylgja twin verify emits (operation twin.verify): the intent conformance report. The twin as its record names it; every assertion derived from the staged bundle's manifest with its outcome, grouped by node and by link; each node's configuration as the record claims it (nodes[].holds against the staged bundle), labelled recorded, never read; every cabled port intent disables, skipped with its reason; the counts by kind; the runs in flight as twin show reads them; and, with --wait, the wait. Advisory: no Fylgja operation reads it. No configuration line, artifact or bootstrap content, device diff, token or login anywhere: the values read are host names, admin states and neighbour names. 014: twin.stage and diverged.towards.stage name the stage (twin.json 6's shape) where they named a waypoint. 015: twin.rehearsal names the rehearsal run whose baseline the twin is, as twin.json 7 records it, or null. 019: twin.snapshot_id, required, names the snapshot of the staged bundle beside its bundle_id, or null; and twin.source admits snapshot, a twin twin create --snapshot built (twin.json's source since 018), which its every step keeps; the two additions beside 019's removals, without a version move (findings.schema.json). 016: a probe's hosts are nodes of the staged bundle, synthesized: nodes[] lists each with psp null and its probe named, no host_name and ports [], and nodes[].bursts the bursts it sends ($defs/burst: one per probe whose first host it is, a burst of its package's count to its second host's address, held when every reply came, failed under verify.burst otherwise, unread when it could not be run); each end of a host's link is skipped, since the host speaks no discovery protocol, and the device port's port_enabled stands; counts.burst counts the bursts, all 0 on a twin with no probe; twin.diverged.phase gains flows. A burst is the container's: the hosts forward in software, so a burst held says the twin's forwarding answered, never a hardware forwarder's. 020: a run in in_flight has no child, since only fylgja-rehearse had one and the rehearsal left the core's worker for the orchestrator (contracts/orchestrator.md); without a version move, pre-1.0 as at 019.

stage.description: 014: the stage a side names, as twin.json 6 records it, or null: its proposed change by id and source branch, its label (a mark's, or branch-point or head), its description and where its at came from

burst.description: 016: one probe's burst, from its first host to its second host's address, of the probe package's burst.count echoes; held when every one was answered, failed (verify.burst) when fewer were, unread when the burst could not be run

from.description: the probe's first host, which sends the burst

far_address.description: the second host's address, without its prefix length

expected.description: the replies expected, the package's count: "5 replies"; "" when the probe package is not loaded

read.description: the replies counted, "4 replies"; null when the burst was not run

error.description: unread: why the burst could not be run

probe.description: 016: what a host is in place of a package: the probe it is an endpoint of, which endpoint, the probe's format and the probe package it was built with, as the manifest names them

outcome.description: held: the value read is the value expected. failed: a value was read and differs. absent: nothing was read, and the package's facet declares no meaning for absence (SR Linux: no update and no error, M6; a facet with `absent` reads that value instead, M7). unread: the read failed at the transport. skipped: not asserted, a port intent disables or a link end on one, with reason.

assertion.description: One assertion about one observable fact of one node, read once over the node's package's readiness transport by the path its conformance facet declares

path.description: the facet's path with {node_name} rendered, filled whenever the node's package is known (a skipped assertion and a node unread for want of an address included); "" only when the package is not

read.description: what was read, as a message quotes it (a string as itself, anything else as its JSON); null when nothing was, or the read failed

error.description: unread: the transport error, the password redacted

port_assertion.description: port_enabled: one cabled port, by its production name and the node's own name for it

end.description: neighbor: one end of a link, which must see the far node and the far port under the far node's own name as the one entry of its neighbour list

port.description: the far node's own name for its port

read.description: every neighbour entry read, as {node, port} from the facet's system_name and port_id leaves; [] when nothing was read, the read failed or the end was skipped; an entry missing a leaf shows "(no <leaf>)"

psp.description: the manifest's nodes[].psp.id; 016: null on a host, which has none

addr.description: <mgmt ipv4>:<readiness port> as dialled: the record's address, else containerlab's; null when the node was not dialled, because it had no address or containerlab did not report it (the record's address is then not used either). 016: a host's management address alone, since a host is not dialled

read.description: false when any assertion of the node is unread

error.description: the first transport error, redacted, when read is false

ports.description: the node's cabled ports, in port order; [] on a host

bursts.description: 016: on a host alone, the bursts it sends, in probe order; [] on a probe's second host

claim.description: the record's claim of what a node holds (twin.json nodes[].holds) against the staged bundle: recorded, never read (answer (c)); never waited on

holds.description: null: containerlab restarted, recreated or created the node and no push landed (M11); a record before 4 reads as its bundle_id

link.description: the link id for a skipped link end; null for the port's own state

twin.description: the twin as its record names it, and the staged bundle the assertions were derived from

snapshot_id.description: 019: the snapshot of the staged bundle: the record's snapshot_id when the staged bundle is the record's, the step's to.snapshot_id when it is the step's target (a diverged twin whose stage landed), and null otherwise, a record naming none included

bundle_id.description: the staged bundle's identity (twin/bundle), which is the record's bundle_id for a ready twin and the target's for a diverged one whose stage landed

rehearsal.description: 015: the rehearsal run whose baseline the twin is, as twin.json 7 records it; null when the record names none, and for a record of 6 or earlier

source.description: 019: snapshot, a twin twin create --snapshot built, kept across every step as twin.json's source is

diverged.description: present when the record is diverged: where the step was going and where it stopped (answer (d))

phase.description: 016: flows, the activity that starts or reads the step's flows

read_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC: the start of the read the block reports (the last read, with --wait)

nodes.description: every node the staged manifest names, in name order

links.description: every link the staged manifest names, in id order

record.description: one claim per record node, and one per node of the staged bundle the record does not name (holds null, failed), in name order

skipped.description: every skipped assertion: a port intent disables, then each end of its link

extra_nodes.description: nodes containerlab reports that the staged bundle does not name; nothing is asserted of them

burst.description: 016: the bursts, held, failed and unread; all 0 on a twin with no probe

in_flight.description: as twin show's, read best-effort under its five-second budget

wait.description: present with --wait alone: the budget, the reads, how the wait ended and after how many seconds from the command's first read. An unread node at expiry ends the command operation.failed, and the block then says so through nodes[].read
